title: How Does Shazam Know What Song Is Playing?
sources: Avery Li-Chun Wang, 'An Industrial-Strength Audio Search Algorithm' (Shazam, ISMIR 2003): spectrogram peaks are kept as sparse 'constellation maps'; pairs of peaks are hashed as two frequencies plus the time difference; a match is a cluster of hashes with a consistent time offset (a diagonal line); identifies music in the presence of voices, traffic noise, dropout and even other music; database of ~1.8-2M tracks at the time

Apple Newsroom, 'Shazam turns 20' (Aug 2022): August 2002, Shazam launches in the UK as a text message service; users dialed 2580 and held the phone up as a song played, then were sent an SMS with the song title and artist name

StereoNET, '2580: Shazam's first killer app was a phone call': launched in the UK on 19 August 2002; call dropped after ~30 seconds; text reply with song title and artist; ~1 million tracks in the launch database

lines.text: How does Shazam name a song in just a few seconds?
lines.caps: HOW DOES *SHAZAM | NAME A *SONG | IN JUST A *FEW SECONDS?

lines.text: Well, your phone listens and turns the sound into a picture,
lines.caps: WELL YOUR *PHONE | *LISTENS | AND TURNS THE *SOUND | INTO A *PICTURE

lines.text: a map of which notes are loudest at each moment.
lines.caps: A *MAP | OF WHICH *NOTES | ARE *LOUDEST | AT EACH *MOMENT

lines.text: It keeps only the brightest peaks, like stars,
and links pairs of them into tiny codes called fingerprints.
lines.caps: AND *LINKS | *PAIRS OF THEM | INTO TINY *CODES | CALLED *FINGERPRINTS

lines.text: Then it checks those codes against millions of songs,
and the song whose codes line up in the same order wins.
lines.caps: AND THE *SONG | WHOSE CODES *LINE UP | IN THE SAME *ORDER | *WINS

lines.text: That's why it still works in a noisy cafe.
lines.caps: THAT'S *WHY | IT STILL *WORKS | IN A *NOISY CAFE

lines.text: The twist? When Shazam launched in two thousand two,
there was no app, you dialed two five eight zero,
lines.caps: THERE WAS *NO APP | YOU *DIALED | *TWO FIVE | EIGHT *ZERO

lines.text: held your phone up to the music, and got a text back.
lines.caps: HELD YOUR *PHONE UP | TO THE *MUSIC | AND GOT A *TEXT | *BACK

lines.text: So every song you hear has a fingerprint, just like you.
lines.caps: SO EVERY *SONG | YOU *HEAR | HAS A *FINGERPRINT | JUST LIKE *YOU
